reviews.author: Amy G
reviews.title: Excellent service from Jasmine
reviews.text: Jasmine the Front Desk Supervisor was outstanding! Answered our questions each and every day. She was a wonderful resource! We had an incredible trip to Scottsdale because of her!

reviews.author: Ambassador571875
reviews.title: Alyssa saved the day!
reviews.text:
This was my first time visiting Scottsdale and this Cesar's Republic, for a much needed respite from the demands of life and running a business. The hotel design, decor, and signature fragrance was magnificent and inviting! Definitely for the grown and sexy. The pool manager was helpful on Saturday, informing us about the best way to secure a chair while we went to get lunch and the wine tasting they would have at the pool later. It was a great way to start our visit and an awesome first impression. They also had a cocktail cart that offered a lovely complementary  drink as you head to the elevators. We spent a lot of the time at the pool. The staffing was appropriate on the weekend days, but absolutely no one to help on the Monday we stayed. It was a total drag to get dressed to get food and drinks from the  adjacent restaurant with no one to check on us. However, there was a lovely woman from the restaurant bar who offered to help me carry our drinks to the pool (Asian, colorful tattoos on arm) . 
I had a suite with a tub and it was absolutely magnificent! Just wish they had bath salts and separate shower gel for the tub since its bolted to the wall. The bed and cleaning staff were top notch. The mall is directly across the street and they have every store you can imagine. They have a complementary golf cart to take you on shorts trips under two miles. The Bell staff was friendly and helpful. Tried the "Vortex", but we were too old to fully enjoy what it offered.  Overall, I had a wonderful visit and would highly recommend this hotel with a few warnings/informational happenings:

1. Early check in will cost you $100
2.Expect your bill at check-in  secure an additional $150 a night for incidentals. Perhaps this is a new industry trend, but I've stayed at some of the best high-end hotels in the world, and never had this happen. This is not on any of the confirmation material or their website. 
2. Upon checkout, I noticed that my bill was significantly more that it should've been (over $500). Id read about this issue in other reviews so I purposely didn't charge anything to the room.  I thought by booking directly through Hilton and not charging anything to the room,  I wouldn't have any of those problems. I showed my confirmation to Kaci on my phone and offered to forward the confirmation email, which I did. Kaci wasn't helpful at all and shared that it was above her pay grade and she wouldn't be able to help me with this issue. She told  me Jasmine was the manager and wouldn't be in until 2:00. I was flying back home and couldn't wait for Jasmine. I never got a call from Jasmine or Kaci regarding this issue. However, my card was charged for the full, wrong amount. 
I called the next day, and asked for the property manager. Luckily, Alyssa answered the phone. She said shed be happy to transfer the call, but asked what it was concerning. I explained my issue, and without missing a beat, she said, "I can help you with that!" Within a few minutes she took care of me with a pleasant, kind, and helpful disposition. It was refreshing to receive the treatment I'm accustomed  to getting from a luxury property. After getting off the phone with her I realized the wrong card was used for the charges although id given the correct card number to Kaci before departing. I immediately called back and asked for Melissa. Kaci shared that Melissa was off and not available. I told her that was impossible because I  just spoke to her on the phone. After a few rounds of back and forth with Kasi, she said, 'Ohhhhhhhhh you must mean Ahhhhhhlysa'.  Yes, Alyssa, because those two names couldn't ever be mistaken over the phone. 
Thanks to Alyssa my stay wasn't completely tarnished, by what she said was a computer glitch.  
There should be more people like her at the front desk!
In summary, Stay here. Its really nice. Just watch your final bill.

reviews.author: 5576miked
reviews.title: Great Location for Shopping
reviews.text: The location is awesome since my wife likes to shop and its proximity to the mall.  The atmosphere is nice.  The rooms are decorated well and worth it.  The restaurant and bar are a great addition with great staff.

reviews.author: VirkinBeautifulBC
reviews.title: Excellent service and perfect stay
reviews.text: Amazing clean modern hotel and excellent location. The rides to nearby locations was so helpful and easy to use.Blake was a rockstar and him and his team really seem to enjoy their work. All staff were great - from the staff at front desk to the Wolf lounge and at the pool -  all were great.

reviews.author: rhartfamily
reviews.title: Beautiful and friendly
reviews.text: The facilities were exquisite but the staff is really what took it over the top. They were young, energetic and attentive. Especially Emma in Pronto. I was there for 3 days and and she remembered my name as well as my

reviews.author: Elaine M
reviews.title: Easter Brunch at Wolf by Vanderpump was Exceptional
reviews.text: I specifically want to write a review for the Wolf by Vanderpump Restaurant at the Caesar's Republic in Scottsdale.  My husband and I had Easter Brunch there.  The restaurant is exquisite! The buffet was remarkable! Our waiter, Blake, doted on us and his service was exceptional!  We had a 1 PM reservation, and the restaurant was packed!  By the time we were seated, they had run out of prime rib and a few of the hot entrees were running low. We mentioned the prime rib and salmon disparities to Blake and he immediately went to the kitchen and brought us  generous helpings of both!  What could have caused me to write a negative review was reversed by Blake's attention to us.  He's a keeper!  Needless to say, we will be returning to Wolf soon.

reviews.author: Dispatch C
reviews.title: It was OK. I expected a little bit better on the food.
reviews.text: Pretty nice place the food has a little bit to be desired.

reviews.author: kesm
reviews.title: Not bad.
reviews.text: They have a staffing issue, a hotel of this caliber should do better. As a HH diamond member we had the manager Jed step in and save the day, so my review went from a 3 to a 4 star. Parking is ridiculous, hotel is usually full with non guests and weekends are busy.

reviews.author: R R
reviews.title: Wonderful experience.
reviews.text: We loved this hotel, the only we missed was the hot tub. The costumer service was excelente. Our housekeeping Verónica González was very attentive and did a wonderful job. We want to mention too to Alex, the houseman, was very helpful. In the front desk Ana and Emilio were helpful too. The guys that help us with the transportation  in the town were wonderful too.

reviews.author: marzzz1
reviews.title: Not coming back...
reviews.text: Last year we reserved a Deluxe Room, High Floor with Valley Views and were given a view of the parking garage roof. The young lady at the front desk was next to useless, would not honor our upgraded reservation after two attempts. Finally had to call in the manager on duty, who finally corrected the situation. But this was ridiculous, we won't do this again.

reviews.author: Yulamnia B
reviews.title: Sophisticated, Stylish, and Unforgettable
reviews.text: This is the definition of a grown and sexy hotel. From start to finish, the experience was exceptional. The management team—Paul and Kenny G—were outstanding and truly elevated our stay. We stayed in a suite, and the room and décor were absolutely stunning—luxurious, modern, and thoughtfully designed. Deva crafted the best Old Fashioned we’ve had in a long time, and the live bar experience was flawless. Everything about this stay felt upscale and intentional. We will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: kaitlyn k
reviews.title: Pet Friendly Overnight Stay
reviews.text: I had a quick 1 night stay with my Shitzu companion and had a great time! Plenty of surrounding grass for my dog and it was amazing having a short walk over to Fashion Mall which was also dog friendly! We had a blast without having to drive anywhere. My room had great views of the mountains and we enjoyed watching the sunrise from the comfort of our bed! The food is amazing. We checked out the Bistro for lunch and breakfast. Both were great. Giada’s breakfast potatoes and lemon cookies are heaven sent! Overall great trip and will definitely be going back!

reviews.author: Stacy C
reviews.title: Sumptuous Spot in Scottsdale!
reviews.text: Friendly staff, clean room, beautiful accommodations! Amazing dining! Loved the location and everything about this hotel! Highly Recommend!

reviews.author: Ryan W
reviews.title: Great Hotel in a Great location!
reviews.text: Had a quick stay here for two nights while in town for a concert. The hotels in a great location and easily walkable to a ton of shops and restaurants. Prior to my arrival Hayden from the concierge’s team reached out and was fantastic at making sure everything we needed was set up for our short visit.  She went over the top to make sure things were just right for our arrival. I also had a great interaction with Ryan the GM. When we checked in the front desk, team was super nice and accommodating. The staff reached out multiple times during our stay to make sure things were going well. The valet team was always prompt and friendly. We had room service for breakfast one morning, which was delicious, but didn’t have a chance to eat at the other restaurants but they look amazing. Very much looking forward to coming back and spending more time at this hotel!

reviews.author: PaigeLO
reviews.title: ZERO out of 10 for front desk staff
reviews.text: The staff at check-in needs customer service training.  I have stayed in hotels just about every week for the last 20 years and I have never had such a cold reception when checking in.  Making matters worse, this was not just one employee, but both that were at the desks the afternoon/early evening of November 8.  Happy to speak to a manager about this rather than waste any more space in my review, if there is any concern.  We really enjoyed Luna as well as the bar there in the lobby - the bartenders took great care of us and had a fun sense of humor!  The rooftop bar on floor 8 is changing concepts, so the offerings were minimal.  Caesars Republic is right in the middle of luxury shopping and dining, so definitely carve out a shopping day or two during your stay.  The hotel itself is new, and nice.  Plenty of space in the room and lots of outlets, a Keurig, robes, and mini fridge.  I checked-in via the app to use digital key and was actually downgraded to a lower floor than I selected, even after waiting until after 4pm for our room, and the view was of the top of a low-rise building.  (Room 441 - 2 queen).  I would seriously think twice before I stayed here again when there are multiple hotels near Old Town Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Nomad91036
reviews.title: Outstanding customer service
reviews.text:
We wanted to express our sincere appreciation for the outstanding service Julie Heaney provided during our recent Conference at Caesar’s Republic from Nov 5-7. Julie’s attention to detail, proactive communication (where she responds to emails within minutes!), and ability to anticipate our needs made the entire event run smoothly from planning to execution.
Our team and attendees commented on how well organized and seamless everything felt — from setup and AV coordination to catering and room changes to ensure that our VIPs received the best rooms and amenities. Her professionalism and calm presence gave us great confidence throughout the event.
Julie consistently went above and beyond to ensure our conference was a success, regularly checking in on our needs. She handled last-minute requests seamlessly and ensured every aspect of the event exceeded expectations.
We truly value the partnership and look forward to working with your team again in the future.
Christine L.

reviews.author: Michael V
reviews.title: “A Five-Star Façade for a Two-Star Motel”
reviews.text:
Caesars Republic Scottsdale (Hilton Curio Collection)
Stayed October 17–27, 2025

The Caesars Republic Scottsdale is a new property hiding a management culture in full collapse. It’s a Hilton-branded hotel that seems to operate without systems, training, or even basic supervision — a masterclass in managerial delusion.

My family stayed for ten nights across two rooms, booking through American Express Travel for the $125 resort credit and late-checkout perks. We also paid over $600 for an extra room on our final day to ensure afternoon use before our flight to London. Despite being told late checkout was impossible, a valet later mentioned the hotel was less than 40% occupied on our departure day.

We had stayed here once before, in August 2024, when it was newly opened. Air-conditioning failed in 110-degree heat, housekeeping couldn’t supply towels, and rooms had no coffee machines. We blamed the chaos on growing pains. When Hilton assumed management, we expected improvement. That was our mistake.

The problems began immediately. Empty shampoo bottles, one roll of tissue, visible dust. Calls to housekeeping went unanswered; supplies arrived hours late or not at all. By day two, we learned to phone before leaving the room at 1 p.m. and to hope someone appeared by evening. When they did, it was cursory — they didn’t actually have a vacuum. The rooms were never actually cleaned, just rearranged.

On October 19th, the toilet broke. It was repaired but the room left filthy, and again untouched by housekeeping. Front Office Manager Jed apologized and promised our destination fees would be removed at checkout. Only a few were removed.
As the week went on, service collapsed entirely. Phones rang unanswered. 

On October 26th, the charade reached its absurd climax. I went to the desk and spoke with Tierra, the manager on duty. She consulted her computer and announced that our rooms were, in fact, spotless and cleaned — she had personally checked them that morning, and any disorder must have been caused by us. When I suggested she accompany me upstairs to see for herself, she refused. When I insisted she was mistaken, she called me a liar. I raised my middle finger. Moments later, she called security. Jay, the hotel guard — reportedly in a romantic relationship with Tierra — arrived and told me I had “disrespected her.” It was a surreal moment: a guest questioning poor service confronted by a display of personal theatrics in the hotel lobby.

After my encounter, my wife returned to the hotel and picked up where I left off. She told Tierra it was impossible she had viewed the rooms and asked to see the housekeeping manager. She was told he was “busy.” My wife said she would wait. 

Eventually, Paul, the housekeeping manager, arrived and accompanied her upstairs. He immediately apologized, acknowledging that the rooms had never been attended to.

Even other employees seemed exhausted by the dysfunction. One valet said he avoids one area at the front when the wind carries the smell of garbage from the bins. Another said a drunken guest vomited at the entrance over the weekend — it took housekeeping four hours to clean.

By checkout (handled by my wife, since I was no longer welcome at the desk), the bill still included some destination fees and only one of the two AmEx resort credits.
To be clear, the building itself is nice — new, modern, well-designed. But management has turned it into an operational farce. Staff are defensive, untrained, and apparently unsupported. Hilton’s oversight is invisible.

Ten nights, two rooms, roughly $15,000 later, one truth remains: this isn’t a luxury hotel. It’s a tale about what happens when incompetence replaces service and a brand name replaces accountability.

reviews.author: Jill C
reviews.title: Customer service response?
reviews.text: Our room was nice the view was ridiculous for 400+ I will upload pictures.  My actually biggest issue is was the lack of response. They texted  me how the room was and when I responded they ignored me to the point I texted again the next day and the response was underwhelming only after I had to send another text 16 hours later .  If you ask a question - customer service is you need to respond.  Especially if you are trying pretend to be a high scale hotel.  I was hoping for a response. If you ask a guest how their stay or room is and then don't continue to answer it says a lot about the whole organizations. My suggestion is don't text and ask our thoughts if you don't really want it.  One  little window n of 3.5 feet wide staring at a cement wall and directly into another hotel room doesn't not justify the price even if the room is lovely.  You are stating that my time is less valuable than yours.  I have actually never done a review on a hotel before and we travel 6 months plus a year so if that tells you the level of disappointment I felt, I am not sure what would.

reviews.author: Kia S
reviews.title: I will definitely stay again.
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The room was very clean and modern and the sunset on the veranda was absolutely beautiful!!

reviews.author: Remi423
reviews.title: Caesar's Republic Scottsdale - great location, great ambience
reviews.text:
Visited Caesar's Republic for the weekend... this place is top tier, first class and a true value for the rack rate. Location adjacent to Fashion Square in Scottsdale is unbeatable and the staff was top notch.

Had dinner at the lobby restaurant - Luna by Giada. Casual but eclectic. Pizza and drinks were great, the space has indoor and outdoor space in the very spacious lobby.  the veranda pool provides great vistas, poolside bars and cabanas. Also, had a quick breakfast at Prontos. Anxious to return when Wolf by Vandercamp opens.

All-in-all from the location to the fitness center, pool and well-appointed rooms, this is a great addition to the line-up of luxury lodging options in Scottsdale. The hotel provides guests golf cart rides to dining or shopping venues in the area.

This is also a benefit for Hilton Honors members as Caesar's is a part of the program.

reviews.author: ronald m
reviews.title: Nice evening
reviews.text: Had a lovely evening out on the patio. The restaurant was a little slower. Jay out server was excellent. Very professional, friendly and experienced…gave us good suggestions and was just the right amount of keeping track of things at the table. Highly recommend him highly recommend the restaurant.

reviews.author: lauren_colton
reviews.title: Best hotel we’ve stayed at
reviews.text: Our stay at Caesar Republic in Scottsdale was truly amazing. We booked last minute for my husband’s birthday and ended up staying in a penthouse thanks to Hayden, their Experience Coordinator. This is definitely a luxury hotel, and they take great pride in keeping it clean and well run. Aiden, one of the Valet, was also amazing. He drove us in the golf cart to Old Town two days in a row, and was very kind and personable. We will definitely be back very soon.

reviews.author: Pano A
reviews.title: Thank you Ryan Kirby and Karen!
reviews.text:
The property is absolutely wonderful — beautifully designed, and always a pleasure to return to.

This was my 6th stay, and once again, the experience was flawless. Ryan Kirby, Karen, and the entire team are truly exceptional. Their warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail make all the difference — they consistently go above and beyond to make guests feel valued and cared for.

Each visit reminds me why this property is one of my absolute favorites. Thank you to everyone for another memorable stay — I’m already looking forward to the next one!

reviews.author: Christine D
reviews.title: Fabulous Ceasars Republic Scottsdale
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this beautiful new property while attending a meeting, and I was very impressed from start to finish. The design is modern yet welcoming, great vibe, comfortable and professional atmosphere.  Loved the guest rooms, they are spacious and well-appointed, simply lovey.

The meeting space was excellent.  Staff was very attentive and ensured everything ran smoothly.  Food and beverage options were fresh and well-presented offering creative breaks and delicious meals.  Also, dinner at Luna was amazing!

What stood out most was the service. The staff was warm and welcoming from the moment I arrived.  Highly recommend Ceasars Republic for a meeting, event or just a get away!

reviews.author: Laura I
reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Caesars Republic is an amazing resort.  The rooms are beautiful, the food is extraordinary, and the staff are the best.  Really enjoyed my stay.

reviews.author: Lon A
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Caesars Republic Scottsdale! The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful, and the atmosphere is both modern and welcoming. The food was outstanding — truly one of the highlights of my visit. My room was spotless, very comfortable, and well taken care of. The staff went above and beyond — everyone I encountered was friendly, attentive, and eager to help.

Whether you’re visiting for business, pleasure, or a mix of both, Caesars Republic takes great care of their guests. I highly recommend staying here — it’s a fantastic experience from start to finish!

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.title: A "must go to" in Scottsdale
reviews.text:
Attended a business meeting at Caesars Republic and I was extremely impressed. Outstanding service, staff, facilities/meeting space and great location in Scottsdale.
The guestroom was so comfortable and very clean and the bed was more than awesome. It was so nice, I will come back here for a leisure stay, too!

reviews.author: Mary Louise G
reviews.title: A Beautiful Oasis in the Desert!
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the NEW Caesars Republic for a business meeting recently and was VERY Impressed with the Hotel and Service.  I am in the Hospitality Industry and not easily impressed but this over night stay was Way Above the normal experience.  The sleeping rooms were Classy/Simple/Modern and well appointed and had everything you would expect in a hotel sleeping room, coffee makers, refrigerators, safes, classy linens, a cool glass shower that could open up into the King bedroom (very cool), lots of ports to plug in your devices and much more.  The meeting space was absolutely Beautiful and very Functional As well.   Everything about our Dinner in Giada's Luna Restaurant was spectacular the night before the meeting.  And to top it off the GREAT location of being right next door to the Scottsdale Fashion Square Indoor Mall and walking distance to Old Town Scottsdale was a HUGE Bonus. Nothing of this caliber exist in Scottsdale or Phoenix, even the high end Resorts don't compare. AND its a Hilton Hotel which means GREAT SERVICE!

reviews.author: Kimberly S
reviews.title: Overall stay
reviews.text: I recently stay at this property; it's in a great location walkable to shopping and restaurants.  I ate in the hotel restaurant Luna, the lemon pasta was amazing.  My guest room had a modern vibe very clean and comfortable bed. I strongly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Compass60561804809
reviews.title: AMAZING PROPERTY!
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! I recently attended a business meeting here with over 40 professionals from the hospitality industry (HelmsBriscoe)—and we’re not easy to impress! The guest rooms were stunning, the meeting space was outstanding, and the food was truly exceptional. I would highly recommend this hotel to both my clients and friends. A big thank you to Karen Campbell and the entire team for such a fantastic experience!

reviews.author: stagingexpert
reviews.title: Don't miss staying at this lovely property!
reviews.text: First the location is perfect but the moment you walk through the door you experience outstanding service in the beautiful setting. The design of the hotel is fresh modern and welcoming. Our group ate at Giada which provided one amazing course after another. Upon entering the room you feel a sense of calm with the floor to ceiling windows and outstanding views. I don’t sleep well in hotel beds and this one I didn’t want to wake up which was added with the black out curtains did make it challenging but hit the switch on electric curtains and I was ready to go after the great shower.  They thought of everything to give you the elevated experience in a guest room. Meeting space is very well done. Plenty of breakouts too. Highly recommend this hotel for business or pleasure!

reviews.author: Ronnee L
reviews.title: Great meeting experience in a fantastic location
reviews.text: We had a great, business meeting at Caesar's Republic Scottsdale.  The hotel is beautiful, the location is amazing and the food, fantastic.

reviews.author: Alexandra S
reviews.title: *WARNING* Your Bathroom Is the View — Safety Nightmare at Caesar’s Republic (Hilton Diamond Member Experience)
reviews.text:
Hilton Diamond Member — WARNING about Caesar’s Republic

Booked a Mountain View Suite for a pre-wedding getaway. Instead, discovered the “view” works BOTH WAYS — straight into the bathroom.
	•	Full glass shower & toilet walls with only flimsy blinds.
	•	NO night tint, NO privacy — we could clearly see into our bathroom from the street, restaurants, and parking lot.
	•	As a woman, I felt unsafe, exposed, and horrified.
	•	Staff response? “Did you close the blinds?” No offer to upgrade, downgrade refund, or help with our six oversized bags.

I work in hotel construction — this is a massive safety oversight for a “luxury” property. The hospitality? Nonexistent. The management’s concern? Zero.

If you value privacy and basic guest service, stay anywhere else.

reviews.author: Bony S
reviews.text: Just wanted to let you know how wonderful our experience was at your gorgeous hotel. From the room to the staff to the food and the golf cart across the street, it was a great time. The fruit platter and waters that were delivered to our room was the icing on the cake. The views from the 10th floor were exceptional, even for someone who doesn’t enjoy heights 😅. Thanks again for allowing us to experience a night at your beautiful hotel 🫶🏻.

reviews.author: 1amGia
reviews.title: Best hotel in the area!!
reviews.text: We booked a night for a girl's night out. The hotel has a luxurious feel and has stunning views from the 7th floor. Luna was delicious I loved the lemon pizza, and the drinks were great as well. The staff was friendly throughout the hotel. Pronto breakfast has good bagels. This hotel is right next to the mall, so it was super convenient for shopping!!  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Tylor P
reviews.title: Unforgettable dining experience.
reviews.text: "Luna exceeded all expectations! From the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel incredibly welcome with their warm and attentive service. The ambiance was cozy yet elegant, creating the perfect setting for a memorable meal. Every dish we tried was absolutely delicious—fresh ingredients, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. It’s clear that a lot of care goes into both the food and the guest experience. Highly recommend Luna to anyone visiting the area looking for a top-notch dining experience!"

reviews.author: Tristen C
reviews.title: Couples escape
reviews.text: After 11 wonderful years of marriage, we decided it was time for a special treat, and Caesar’s Republic was absolutely perfect. From the moment we arrived, we felt pampered—those plush robes and slippers made us feel like royalty. It’s the ideal escape for a couple looking to indulge and reconnect; every detail whispers luxury and comfort. Luna restaurant was a highlight—fabulous food that delighted our senses and made our date night truly memorable. The staff was so warm and attentive, making us feel like cherished friends rather than guests. Spending the weekend there reminded us how important it is to celebrate life’s special moments together. Honestly, we’re so happy we chose Caesar’s Republic—it's a little piece of paradise.

reviews.author: Stacey L
reviews.title: Fourth of July Heaven
reviews.text:
I stayed at Caesars Republic Scottsdale over the 4th of July and it was pure perfection. The highlight? The rooftop pool —amazing cabana service, great cocktails, and unreal views.

Poolside service was top-tier—the staff brought delicious tacos and drinks right to me and brought me some extra towels. Tacos + cocktails + views = heaven.

My suite overlooked the city, and from my balcony I watched the fireworks over various parts of the city.

Overall, the atmosphere, room upgrade, and attentive service (especially the front desk who upgraded me) made this a 5-star resort experience. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a relaxing yet indulgent Scottsdale vacation!!!!!

reviews.author: Shaun T
reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.text: The food in Luna was really good.  We had pasta and apps and desserts, and everything was great.  Looking forward to seeing what they can do with Wolf

reviews.author: RABKZJ1213
reviews.title: A Gem in the heart of Scottsdale!
reviews.text: Caesars Republic is an amazing property! Location, cleanliness, staff, decor, restaurants are all top notch.  The rooms were so spacious & comfortable. The view from the terrace was absolutely stunning. We spent a week with the family & could not ask for more! Not to mention the upscale Fashion Square- few steps away :)

reviews.author: kaitlyn k
reviews.title: Perfect way to experience Scottsdale
reviews.text: Great location. Able to walk to restaurants and fashion mall. Unique rooms. Great views of the mountains.  A great escape for anyone visiting Scottsdale. Definitely coming back.

reviews.author: Katie H
reviews.title: Why SEVEN is the Venue You’ve Been Waiting For
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for the best place to throw a party, look no further than SEVEN. From the moment you walk in, the energy is electric. The venue is stylish, spacious, and designed for fun—perfect for any celebration, big or small.

The staff at SEVEN are top-notch, always attentive and ready to help you with whatever you need. I especially loved my Event Sales Manager, Melissa. I couldn't have done it without her! The band, lighting, tomahawk steak stations and more  created an incredible atmosphere. No matter what event you are celebrating, SEVEN knows how to make it memorable.

I’ve been to a lot of venues, but SEVEN stands out as the best. If you want a night to remember, this is the place to be!

reviews.author: PlatinumPaul
reviews.title: This shouldn't be a three star review.
reviews.text:
But, it has to be due to a few factors.  Always enjoyed eating here since the property opened a couple of  years ago, so my wife and I were really excited to be spening the night for once.  Arrived early and inquired about an upgrade to a suite as rates were really low and thus occupancy should be as well.  After back and forth we were given the option for a suite with a rate to be determined but around a certain price.  We were told to check back later on this as the room had to be cleaned first.  Being intelligent, I thought to check what the room was going for online before actually committing to anything.   Lo and behold, the "upgrade" would cost more than if we just booked the suite online.  So, when we were called back about the rate I brought this up.   The rate was magically brought down to the price shown online.  How is that a deal?  So after back and forth we got an acceptable number, lower than the one shown online, and a late check out.  

The suite itself was absolutely stunning and is a big reason why this review isn't rated lower.  Beautiful decor, lots of space, very comfortable bed.  Only gripe with the suite was that housekeeping left a bit to be desired.  The mini bar refrigerator had sticky stuff on one shelf and there were bits of trash on the floor of the bedroom.  Also, the air conditioner struggled to cool the room (especially the living room) during the day.  At night it was perfectly fine.  Probably due to a combination of eco-friendly nonsense, large windows, and the blazing Arizona sun.  Still, if it's hard to get the living room below 74 during a 95 degree day, what happens when it's 116 outside?  

Drinks at Luna by Giada were delicious and the bar staff very nice.  Glad we stopped here before our reservation at Seven.  Speaking of Seven, we've always liked this restaurant.  Allison and Jen were good bartenders and were very personable.  Food was excellent.  A longtime favorite of ours is the charred onion dip which we ordered.  My wife's steak frittes was the best we've ever had.  Loved my ancho alfredo pasta too.  The downside was the kitchen seemed to forget our order.  Took an hour to get our mains.  Thankfully, the great bar staff rectified this.  Sadly, Seven is soon being replaced by Vanderpump.  

Thing is, after all this I was still willing to give the place four stars.  That changed on the day of check out.  Twice we confirmed a late checkout with the front desk and were told no problem.  While getting dressed in the bedroom I thought I heard a knock over the sound of the TV.  A housekeeper ignored our privacy sign and came in the room.  I shouted out from the bedroom the room was occupied and they left.  A few minutes later I get a call from the front desk asking if I was planning on staying over for the day.  I explained we were promised a late checkout and would be leaving at that time.  The rep said this was fine and she'd note the system, again.  About an hour later another knock at the door from housekeeping.  Apparently they didn't get the third memo about the late checkout.  Thankfully, I was dressed this time.  

Eventually go to check out and go over the bill.  They forgot to add an Arizona resident credit we booked our room under (my wife and I split our time between AZ and CA, and have AZ licenses, plates, etc.), so I had to wait for that to get fixed.  

There are just too many issues here for me to recommend staying here, which is sad as I always liked this hotel and wanted to stay here on a staycation.  It seems though, stuff falling through the cracks is a Hilton problem which is why we usually stay at Hyatt or Marriott properties.   Whoever is in charge here, get things in order.  This property is too nice to be run in the slipshod manner which it currently is.

reviews.author: Howard K
reviews.title: A Massive Challenge Turned Into a Massive Win!
reviews.text:
In short, I need to commend Julie Larkin (Manager) and her team. I arrived on Tuesday, May 20th and there was an issue with my booking. As it was booked through a work travel platform, there wasn't an immediate connect for me to get help from. Julie went above and beyond what she needed to, insuring not only was I checked in without additional steps or challenges, but proceeded to help get my co-worker checked in! 

This could have been a serious issue, and caused me personal challenges. Julie stepped in, was pro-active and came up with a solution. She was incredibly pleasant and engaging and we ended up having quite the laugh! 

To the Hilton corporate leadership, Julie represented what great problem solving and leadership looks like! Well done Julie!

reviews.author: RachelleG
reviews.title: Unexpected surprise!
reviews.text: Such an unexpected surprise! Jay was our waiter and he was terrific…so knowledgeable and full of great suggestions and personality! One of the best Caesar salads we’ve ever had.  Highly recommend the Focaccia bread and lemon spaghetti. All of the ingredients are flown in from select parts of the country like flour, meat, seafood, cheese…all are premium quality and perfectly pared. My husband got the Nodi Marini Ala Vodka (which was also delicious). Their pizzas and other entrees all looked delicious too! We will be back for sure! Our new favorite restaurant!

reviews.author: D i
reviews.title: A great new hotel!
reviews.text: We loved our room and service there.  We're Hilton Vacation Club owners and wanted to try this. We found it just great with great service for our golf clubs and rental car.  We would recommend trying it, especially when the weather is good in the spring.

reviews.author: Rebecca C
reviews.title: Exquisite and Unique Hotel with Fantastic Views, Food, and Nightlife
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel over the holidays last year, and it was breathtaking.  The views from the hotel room were beautiful, and the sunrises and sunsets from this hotel are some of the best I have ever seen. I would highly recommend staying here for anyone who is visiting Arizona or who just wants a getaway staycation.  The restaurant, Luna by Giada, has delicious home-cooked meals that make you feel like you are right in Italy.  This hotel offers a variety of resources for all age groups and also provides a fun nightlife environment at the Seven restaurant and bar on the 7th floor. The pools are beautiful for people who enjoy lounging all day, and the hotel is exquisite and modern.  I would highly recommend anyone coming to Arixona to stay here at the Caesar's Republic Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona.

reviews.author: mikeschusteraz
reviews.title: Great location, friendly staff!
reviews.text: Stayed here for a quick trip with work. Everyone working there was super friendly. The front desk made check-in easy, and the bartenders and servers I met were all genuinely nice. Great location right next to the mall, so I was able to get some shopping done right next to the hotel in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: Robert A
reviews.title: 70th birthday party
reviews.text: Held my wife’s 70 th birthday at the Caesars Republic Scottsdale. Had My four kids and their spouses fly in for the weekend. The hotel is first class.  The hotel rooms were meticulously clean the service and staff were friendly and efficient.  We were treated like family and highly recommend the hotel for any special occasion or no occasion!

reviews.author: Perilyn O
reviews.title: Spoiled by Caesars Republic
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and accommodations! The Caesar's staff was amazing at every turn. Great location in Scottsdale close to shopping, hiking and sights. We ate at Luna twice, and would again! The most relaxed four days we have ever had at a hotel. We will be back!!

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: Operational issues abound, but the property sure is gorgeous
reviews.text:
My 2 room suite room reservation got downgraded on my day of arrival. I only noticed this in the app when I landed. As a Honors Gold member, or at any of my frequent Hyatt (Globalist) or Marriott (Titanium) stays, this has never happened to me. I actually had to ask about this at the front desk, they were processing my check in as if I wouldn't notice. They just explained that they were overbooked for the weekend. We tried to find a solution, which ended up with me being given two rooms after some negotiating, which should NOT have been necessary. While the front desk staff did their best, none of them had the authority to resolve this to my satisfaction, leading to a lot of back and forth with a manager who never made an appearance. The lines at check in were always slow because of folks needing to resolve issues. I know of at least two other reservations that had issues like this, or similar. It is not good. The situation still has not been resolved several days later. 

The property is amazing, the rooms are beautiful. The service at the pool was hit and miss. One day, the pool waitress was about 30-45 minutes wait time for orders to arrive. Supposedly the bar was "backed up" but inside, you could see they were not that busy. An order was lost. An order of drinks came with all of the ice melted. Meaning, it was made and sitting there. The day prior, the server was fantastic. Just hit and miss. 

The rooms and facilities were amazing though and the location is great. But just know there are a lot of operational issues at this hotel.

reviews.author: Camille C
reviews.title: Will not be returning.
reviews.text:
One of my worst Hilton experiences. As many others have mentioned, there’s an immense lack of customer service from staff. Quite cold and unaccommodating. Hilton status gets you nothing. They do not go over any amenities unless you specifically ask. The room it’s self had a neat lay out, though it only had one tiny window in the way back with views of vents only. Impeccable. 
Water pressure is comical for how large it is. Restaurant host in lobby wouldn’t acknowledge me. They proceeded to forget my order and made me feel unwelcome as a solo traveler. Definitely not worth the price. I highly recommended elsewhere.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.title: Overall good - but not great.
reviews.text:
I stayed at this hotel with a friend this month, and overall it was nice. Location was excellent, right next to the mall and near the bars and restaurants. Beautifully decorated, quiet and comfortable - but there were a few disappointments. 

I rang reception on a Sunday morning for two orange juices and some water and was told to download an app - I requested where to find the information and the guy said "idk i've never been in the rooms". He was polite but what? This is a $400 a night hotel - I should be able to order an orange juice to my room? In the end, my friend had to go to the bar to fetch it.

Another flag was the cleanliness, there were dustbunnies under the side table and the shower had hair in it when we arrived. Not a huge deal but for the price? Not ideal.

Overall i'd recommend but I was a little bit disappointed with the service.

reviews.author: ALEJANDRO A
reviews.title: Not worth trying
reviews.text: Terrible experience. Check in was at 4:00 and we didn’t get our room until after 5:00 pm. I reserved a premium suite with Mountain View and was given a different room as an “upgrade” which was right at the pool/bar area. The music there was super loud at night and my kids couldn’t sleep. When I called the front desk to ask to turned down the music they said they couldn’t do that and that the music would stop at 2:00 am when the bar closes. Also, the room was not very clean. There was dust on all surfaces and the bathrooms smelled bad. We won’t be back.

reviews.author: Sondra J
reviews.title: Don't plan to stay here until you verify Hilton has it under control
reviews.text: Checked out this morning after 3-day stay. It was a fiasco from start to finish. We arrived about 2:00 pm on Thursday, February 27th, knowing checkin time was 4:00 pm and willing to wait.  We had 3 rooms reserved, 1 large suite and 2 regular rooms. Reception said the suite was cleaned,  only needed to be inspected, and she would expedite the inspection. However, it turned out to be after 4 before we were assigned rooms. One of the single rooms assigned was occupied when we unlocked the door! The large suite was advertised as 670 square feet in size. However, the majority of the square footage was in the shower and bathroom. Housekeeping for the suite was good, but unacceptable in the single rooms. The housekeeper discarded bottles of water with water in them, and we had purchased the water because it wasn't furnished in the room. The first night, there was 1 towel and 1 washcloth in the bathroom. The second night they only left 1 towel. There was NOTHING in the suite other than what could be purchased. We bought wine, but there was no wine opener. When we requested a wine opener, we were told they didn't have any. We went to the bar to see if we could borrow a wine opener and were told a staff member would come to the room to open our wine, but they couldn't leave the opener. Upon checking in Thursday, there was only 1 valet on duty, and he was busy parking cars so we were left on our own to get the luggage to our rooms. One of two ladies at reception took pity on us and helped us to our rooms. She was surprised when one of the rooms was occupied. This should be enough negative information to understand my low rating even though I could offer more.

reviews.author: Excursion67559535551
reviews.title: Amazing Astrid
reviews.text: Astrid was amazing! She went above and beyond to give me insight to explain the hotel amenities. She is very knowledgeable and kind. This employee deserves a bonus for just going out of her way and keeping a smile on her face at the same time. As a frequent traveler, I wish everyone was this happy.

reviews.author: ginawired
reviews.title: Death by a Thousand Cuts - So many issues and no accountability
reviews.text:
TLDR - Lots of little issues adding up to a disappointing and stressful stay at the new (less than a year old) Scottsdale Caesars Republic. Totally unacceptable and the lack of accountability is the main reason for the bad review. . 

Check in - went smoothly but at no point during check in were we told that the $30 per day credit was only good at the convenience store or Pronto (breakfast spot). I was later told that it was also good at Luna but not Seven. 

Food - Luna was highly disappointing. The lemon spaghetti sauce was broken/grainy and the rest of the food was just meh. The service and wine were both excellent as were the cookies for dessert, but a $750 meal for 3 should be excellent. It was not. 

Pronto - gross - truly a huge disgusting miss. It’s more of a grab and go than a restaurant. You can order made to order items too, but they aren’t good. We got 2 coffee drinks, the traditional breakfast and the frittata. The coffees were fine but even though they gave us a number for our table they called out for us to pick up the coffees. The lids (paper cups) don’t fit and my husband scalded his hand picking them up. The worker says, “oh yea the lids are like that” (seriously!?). Then when the food was delivered and I realized we didn’t receive the toast so I went to the counter to inquire. The same worker who delivered our meal to our table said “oh you didn’t get it?” (Obviously she had just delivered it without toast). Then someone else proceeded to bring out 1 piece of dry toast without butter or jam, but he brought some after we asked for it. Despite being a glorified Panera, they have a 20% tip as the pre populated suggestion on the touch screen which I gave thinking it would influence service - it didn’t. 

Housekeeping was hit and miss. Day one - a used (by us) washcloth was left in the shower. Trash and used glasses were not removed and toilet paper was not refreshed causing us to completely run out of TP on day 3. The shower has no shelf or soap dish for bar soap or personal toiletries (facial cleanser, razor etc). The shower was stocked with 2 conditioners and 1 shampoo - no shower gel. When I requested shower gel, it was left on the counter rather than being installed so I ended up perching it on top of the duplicate conditioner since there was no where else to put it. Day 2 housekeeping didn’t come at all even when though we were gone from 9-1 and after 5. I had to go to the front desk at 10 pm after returning from dinner to ask for fresh towels, coffee pods, Kleenex (because we were had been out of TP) and TP. It all got left in a pile on the countertop. I finally texted the front desk and  asked if no one in the hotel had a key to fix the shower gel situation and someone came the following morning. 

Lighting is awful -  major design issues - entry hall lighting is very dim and not adequate to even see my suitcase while situated on the luggage rack. It’s unclear and not intuitive what turns off all lighting. (Bedside light won’t go off and on sometimes- despite some lights being on). All lights seem to be controlled by the bedside switch on the far side of the room. I was told the “owner” owns a lighting company and that this is an efficiency thing - no I can assure you it isn’t - I work in adjacent business and personally understand how this works. Just say you messed up the lighting don’t gaslight me that it’s “green”. 

Valet parking - I texted (as instructed) and got no reply. After 20 minutes I went to the front desk to inquire if I had done something wrong and was told they were short staffed. My car was brought around 5 minutes later. They weren’t busy and no other customers were waiting. Not what I expect when paying $40 for valet. 

Complementary shuttle - we only used this once and were dropped off at a nearby (.5 miles away) restaurant no problems. We opted for this on our final night at around 4:30 on a Monday. Got a ride right away to the destination but waited over an hour for the ride back after being told 5-10 minutes. After 20 minutes waiting  I called and was told 20-30 more minutes. Then I was called to say it was 5 minutes away. At the 1 hour mark, I was told the that the cart had been waiting for us for 20 minutes and left. This was a straight up lie since the restaurant is located on a dead end and we were waiting on the street with visibility to traffic coming in and out. The manager finally picked us up herself but still questioned if we had really been at the entrance the whole time. Yes we had definitely been waiting because we were anxious to get back to the hotel and face time our daughter for her birthday. We ended up doing this on the golf cart ride back. 

I expected better of this beautiful hotel in a great location and was gravely disappointed. I hope to be compensated for my time to write up this detailed and thorough feedback, because I love Hilton and want to participate in keeping quality high. Some local employees seemed genuinely embarrassed - I could tell they know it’s bad and feel powerless to improve it.

reviews.author: Jackie L
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text: Cleanest hotel I’ve stayed at in years.  The shower is spotless, the aesthetic is perfect.  I’m not a huge fan of elevators but these are quite reliable and fast.  The pools are luxurious and the views are spectacular. Great fitness facility….cool vibe all around.

reviews.author: Kris Z
reviews.title: Come Hungry!
reviews.text: As a local event planner, I had the pleasure of attending the grand opening of Caesars Republic when they first opened, but hadn't had a chance to eat at any of the restaurants yet.  Last month, that changed, and I was able to grab a lovely dinner with some girlfriends at Luna by Giada.  HOLY MOLY was the food amazing.  Brandi was our server- she knew the menu in and out and was so helpful.  We over ordered, naturally, but even the leftovers were amazing.  Highly recommend bringing any pasta or pizza lovers to dinner here.  Also, loved the ambience of the entire experience.  Will def be back.

reviews.author: liveandlove2travel
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: He stayed three nights at the Caesars Republic in January for my birthday trip. The hotel is beautiful. Check in was late and odd. I think the person working at check-in was new as he was really unable to answer most questions. Supposedly we were upgraded because  my husband is a diamond member but it didn’t feel or look like it. We’ve had some pretty grand upgrades and this room looked exactly like the picture of the room we booked. The bed was comfortable, and most of the room amenities were great. A little surprised that a luxury hotel would have a Keurig in the roomversus a Nespresso? It was also inconvenient that the room came with a steamer instead of an iron. There is no plug to steam your clothes where you can hang them, and there is nowhere to hang your clothes where you can plug in the steamer. I ended up requesting a regular iron which someone was able to bring with an ironing board. Both were really poor quality. It just feels odd when the place looks luxurious, but uses tools that you would likely find in some cheap motel. we enjoyed using the properties bikes. We also enjoyed our breakfast daily with our diamond credits. The staff was very friendly throughout. We particularly enjoyed sitting in the afternoons on the seventh or eighth floor deck till sunset - stunning views! Parking is a real racket. Valet parking is I think $40? And self parking is $28. Guess what, where you park your car for $28 a night is the exact same parking deck where you can park for free on any of the other levels….

reviews.author: GregorioOenophile
reviews.title: Beautiful property but won't be staying there again.
reviews.text: The hotel is new and trendy, and the rooms are nicely appointed. I have no complaints with the property. My reason for three stars is service, and I was surprised by the fees.  I read about many travelers getting upgraded and positive reviews about the staff.  I usually stay at a different Hilton property in Scottsdale, but I thought I'd try this one.  When I checked in, I inquired about a Diamond upgrade and the front desk person said the manager takes care of that in the morning and I wasn't upgraded.  She seemed surprised, so I asked if she could check on availability.  She apologized but said there wasn't anything she could do.  I found it odd that a person in that position couldn't check and decide whether or not to upgrade me.  Most front desk personnel are empowered to make those decisions.   Then when I checked out, I was billed $51.31 a day as a resort or convenience fee.  I was staying on points and never had I had the resort fee or whatever fees they are charging posted to my account when using points.  In addition, there's no parking on site unless you valet at $40/day.  You have to park at the Fashion Mall garage.  There's a small lot in front of the hotel, but signage stating "No Hotel Parking".  In summary, great facility but felt nickel and dimed at every opportunity.  The other property I stay at has the same amenities - rooftop pool and bar, modern fitness center, newly built hotel, and parking in the garage or on the street and there's no convenience or resort fee.  Plus they usually upgrade me even when staying with points.

reviews.author: Charmaine L
reviews.title: Amazing staff, great location, wonderful new property!!!!
reviews.text: Very  comfortable bed and pillows, clean, awesome location!  Staff were excellent! Genie, Ziggy , are the names I remembered well! I believe the other gentleman I should note were named Rah and Zay.   Thank you for a great stay!!! Already booked again !

reviews.author: Lance G
reviews.title: World class service
reviews.text:
The atmosphere and food was wonderful but it was our server , Kaitlyn that made the experience incredible. Thank you Kaitlyn!

The atmosphere and food was wonderful but it was our server , Kaitlyn that made the experience incredible. Thank you Kaitlyn!

reviews.author: malofsky
reviews.title: Wonderful 60Th Birthday from an outstanding, warm and fun staff!
reviews.text:
First, a powerful, wonderful, special thank you to whole team here, but especially to Astrid, Keri, Jeany and Faye!

Came for my 60th birthday (yuck but yay) and those ladies went absolutely over the top for me and my family.  

As a lifetime Diamond and a diamond for 25 plus years, the appreciation showed.  The upgraded room, the ballon arch, the chocolate strawberries arranged with my wife, Robin, it’s been a very welcoming, warm experience.  

We’ll be back!  You should too. 

The only danger?  Being with steps literally of some of the finest shopping and dining in the world.

Thank You All!

Adam & Robin

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Excellent, classy and welcoming
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, and the restaurants and bars vibrant, but what really made our stay special was the excellent customer service and helpful vibe that Keri provided. She was very cheerful and positive and made us feel welcome! The gentleman at check-in was great too, with tips on the hours of restaurant and bar service. Great folks!

reviews.author: Mike P
reviews.title: Amazing service & Ambiance.
reviews.text: Jay & Blake was the best and most  informative persons helping decide what to eat and knowledgeable in the menu which helped everyone decide what to eat which was amazing. Excellent service & food was amazing . Jay Recommended the Ribeye steak plate which was delicious.

reviews.author: Shan P
reviews.title: Jay is the host to ask for!
reviews.text: Jay was fantastic, he’s the reason I’d come back outside of the food! The Pizzas are go to, I had the mushroom one. Drinks are on point, spend a little time at the bar before your reservation. The bartenders spend extra attention to you while you’re waiting.

reviews.author: Armani M
reviews.title: Amazing Dining Experience at Luna
reviews.text: Last night, my family and I had the pleasure of dining at LUNA, the lobby restaurant, and it was an unforgettable experience! From the moment we arrived, the hostesses made us feel welcome, sharing the rich history of Luna as they guided us to our table—a thoughtful touch that set the tone for the evening. Our server, Amanda, was exceptional, recommending one of the finest bottles of red wine I’ve ever had. The food was absolutely delicious, and we loved the family-style servings that made the meal even more enjoyable. A special highlight was when GM Paul personally stopped by to check in on us and make sure everything was perfect. It was my brother’s birthday, and they went above and beyond, surprising us with a couple of desserts, including one with a candle. Great vibes, fantastic food, superb wine, and top-notch service. We’ll definitely be back. Thank you for making the evening so memorable!

reviews.author: Aaron F
reviews.title: Perfect place for a Holiday Party
reviews.text: We held our company department holiday gathering at Caesars and the event was a major success. We had 150 people on the veranda overlooking camelback mountain and had a great time. The food, views, and event space were A+. The only thing better was the service by the entire staff. The event was managed by Julie Heaney and I can’t recommend this venue enough. We look forward to more events at this venue in the future.

reviews.author: kuandz
reviews.title: Great hotel stay
reviews.text: Caesars Republic in Scottsdale was an amazing place to get to stay. Our room was comfortable, clean and had a great view of Camelback. Dinner at Lunas was delicious and the staff in the restaurant went above and beyond to take care of us. All of the staff from the office to the restaurants to front desk and housekeeping were all friendly and great. All the Christmas decorations made it even more special.

reviews.author: Rick T
reviews.title: Scottsdale at its best
reviews.text:
Great stay.
Friendly staff
Great room.
If you are visiting Scottsdale, Caesars Republic is the place to stay and eat.
Excellent views of the city and Camelback mountain.
Night life is always busy with something happening.
…………………………………………………………………………………………………………

reviews.author: jean pierre s
reviews.title: getting in the top pool late at night so fun
reviews.text: Faye at front desk was a 12 on 10. Great service!! she did everything she could to make the experience great! The rooms are super nice ! The pools are great both at 7 th floor or the biggest one at floor level. the view is just amazing on the 7 th floor ! Food is very good at both restaurants !   overall the place is a 10 on 10!

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: Top hotel
reviews.text: faye was amazing at front desk !! 12 on 10 top service and a real sunshine ! Hotel is great ! Also the pool at 7 th floor has a great view! Food is good ! the beds are awesome! The vibe and quality of the clients is nice upscale but not snobby! Had an amazing time

reviews.author: Craig O
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
No hot water 4 out of 5 nights. Cold showers.  Water pressure was non existent.

Checked in and found beer bottle and someone had been on my bed. 

I ask multiple tjmes about hot water and they said they’d send someone up but issue never resolved. 

Other than that beautiful hotel. Do something about the water

reviews.author: Ahmed A
reviews.title: Caesar republic
reviews.text: I went to visit Scottsdale with my friend and stayed at this hotel and I just wanted to say I had a wonderful stay. Emilio helped me a lot and the italian food was 10 out of 10, so as the restaurant staff did a great job with the service and friendliness they provided.

reviews.author: Hannah K
reviews.title: Needs some work
reviews.text: Being that the hotel opened earlier this year, I understand they are still ironing out some wrinkles. My first impression was that this is a lovely hotel in a fantastic location in the heart of Scottsdale's Fashion Center. I arrived early to see if I could get an early check-in and if not was happy to check my bags until the room was ready.  I waited a few minutes to see if a valet would direct me where I could park to check on the room, but no one came out. When I got to the front desk the valet approached me asking for my keys while spoke with guest registration. I had reserved and prepaid for the Canyon De Chelly Suite (approx 989 sq ft). When they asked if I would like to pre-register I said sure and confirmed that I was in that suite. They said they had me in the antelope canyon suite (767 sq ft). I let them know that was not the room I booked and paid for. The woman helping me spoke with her manager and as the Chelly suites were being occupied I was upgraded to the peralta suite. It was a great room; what was not great was the previous guest's used earplugs, pills, and other items found in the drawers that housekeeping failed to check or the bar that was not restocked. For a room that costs in the area of $2400 a night depending on time of year, they need to do better. When I let the front desk know initially they simply said thank you for letting us know. At check out I asked that they remove the amenities charge as the amenities were definitely lacking. The hotel definitely has potential but it is not there yet.

reviews.author: Happy Explorer
reviews.title: THE PLACE TO STAY IF YOUR GOING TO SCOTTSDALE
reviews.text:
One word, AMAZING!!!
Really, the place is awesome. 
To start, the staff are so kind and helpful.  Truly care.  Front desk Polivia at the front desk was so nice and put us in a great room.
Karie the concierge was so helpful and recommended great restaurants and bars to go go to.
Everyone from he bellman to the restaurant staff, they truly were top notch.
The rooms are killer, automatic blinds, super conformable beds, bathroom is very nice.  The hotel is brand new and you literally feel like you are in a vegas hotel without the smoke and casino.  

Also, the location is directly next to a huge high class mall.  Not that I generally go to malls, this mall was beautiful and had every store you can imagine.  50 feet away from the hotel.  

We travel a lot and good service is hard to find theses days but not here.  I cant recommend this place enough.  Stay here, it might just be the best decision you make your entire trip!

Hope you have as great of a stay as my wife and I did.

reviews.author: Nancy P
reviews.title: A MUST STAY!
reviews.text: GREAT PLACE TO STAY. NEXT TO THE FASHION MALL AND RESTAURANTS NEARBY. SUPER CLEAN AND NEW HOTEL.THE BED IS COMFY THE ROOMS ARE NICE A SPACIOUS. THE STAFF WAS VERY FRIENDLY. HUNG OUT BY THE POOL AND NICE FRIENDLY STAFF. GREAT DRINKS AND FOOD BY THE POOL. WOULD LOVE TO GO BACK!

reviews.author: Traci A
reviews.title: Comfy and Cozy
reviews.text: Wow. This hotel was so comfy and cozy. The rooms were very nice, and the decor was done in great taste. The location was perfect for the rhings i needed to get done during my stay. The hotel nicely decorated grounds.Staff is friendly and helpful, will definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Dante A
reviews.title: Awesome Stay
reviews.text: We came to Scottsdale for a friends 25th birthday. This was  an extremely clean establishment and the front desk we’re nothing but helpful! The room was very put together and had enough space for all our bags and accessories.  A definate must stay! “

reviews.author: Jimmy C.
reviews.title: 11/10 Premier Experience!
reviews.text:
Over the top experience in every aspect! 

Service staff: 11/10

Cleanliness: 11/10

Maintenance: 11/10

Design & Decor: 11/10

Food & Beverage: 11/10 

Surrounding Area: 11/10

Paul (Luna), Brody (Luna), and Zade (Sales) amongst the standouts!

reviews.author: Jason C
reviews.title: Caesars Republic is Amazing!
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel. The staff were fantastic and very helpful. 
The views from the bar of the 7th floor were breathtaking!
We ate that restaurant  Luna. I'm still thinking about the Lemon Speghetti. 
I've already started planning my next trip. Can't wait!

reviews.author: mcmessina17
reviews.title: Elegant, but still very inviting and serene
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, upscaling and modern without feeling stuffy. The rooms are very well done, with attention to detail and have a tranquil yet minimalistic feel. Incredible hospitality from the staff. I enjoyed the peaceful views and delicious drinks at Seven bar in the hotel.

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Second To None Experience
reviews.text:
Stayed at Caesars Republic last month for a quick business trip & client entertainment and could not have been more impressed with the amenities, service & cleanliness.  Upon arrival, I was promptly greeted by Faye at the front desk who did an amazing job with explaining all the hours and locations of various outlets.

I stayed in room 420 and not only was it clean and still had that new hotel smell to it, but the attention to detail in the rooms from the mascot wolf in the pillows to the bottles of liquor on the shelves to the little mini-bar, these guys really have thought of it all.  The bed was super comfortable and the towels still felt brand-new.

During one of my nights, I hosted a couple of the clients I came out to see at Seven, which is their 7th floor lounge with remarkable views of Camelback Mountain & just as memorable service.  Lauren was our server and took exceptional care of myself and my clients during the few hours we were there and provided an experience that they are still talking about to this day.  We were lucky enough to watch the sunset over the mountain during our meal and while everything was delicious, I had the grapefruit glazed salmon and it was truly the best salmon I've ever had (even living in Portland and visiting Seattle & Alaska frequently).

All in all, my stay and experience at Caesars was incomparable to any other hotel I've stayed at in Scottsdale and can see why this is quickly becoming THE place to be.  I can't wait for my next trip in September!

reviews.author: Elizabeth P
reviews.title: BEWARE they charge $40 to valet park
reviews.text: BEWARE they charge $40 per night to valet park and don’t tell you up front.  As you pull up to the front of the hotel and get out of your car there is a sign that says Valet is $8.00.  On the drive home from the hotel my bank App charged me $40.  I called the hotel immediately and spoke to a manager named Martha.  Martha said the $40 charge was on the ticket when we gave the keys to the valet.  I told Martha there was no ticket given.  Martha said the ticket is a text message.  I searched my phone-no text message.  Martha said as a courtesy she would reimburse us $20.  The credit never showed up.

reviews.author: Stacie Baird
reviews.title: Trying to be 5 Star for this Hotel but not meeting the bar for Scottsdale Resort expectations.
reviews.text:
Just missed the mark…so far.   A 3 star that had potential.  As serial staycation-ers in Scottsdale, note this is not a resort but a hotel for various reasons listed.  This place could step up and work out the “just opened” misses and others may be tough to fix.  They are still working out the kinks as there was blue tape still up in the room behind the bathroom door.   We look for certain amenities which is individual preference.  Other elements are universal expectations.  
 
Room: Boynton Suite (note these are on the lower floors and no balcony so the view can be limited even with floor to ceiling windows. ). You are looking out at the mountain and over Goldwater boulevard with both foot and car traffic)

Below is a list of pros and cons:

Pro:
Great view in some of the rooms of Camelback and the other side is a view of the mall. 

Multiple pools with the adult side giving the impressive view and experience.

The onsite restaurants were beautiful and full disclosure we did not try the food (see no room service)

Bed was comfortable. 

Staff was kind and were offered champagne or water multiple times.

Cons:
NO ROOM SERVICE: This was a big one on the day after staying up and would have to Postmates to get food which we can do from home. 

Blackout shades are not blackout and our shades did not come all the way down leaving the room drenched in the AZ sun by 5:30AM. Also caused the heat in the room to be oppressive when we arrived the interior temp was 80 degrees with the AC working overtime for a few hours to bring down the temp.

Bathroom has no separate toilet room/fan which for some couples or others staying with mixed groups is unfortunate. 

Our shower was huge with a great view, and was a ton of wasted space. The shower head was in a corner with only one of the two heads working correctly.  Only a single sink which doesn’t feel like “suite” vibes. 

Pillows were TERRIBLE with no extras offered. 

Valet option is $40 which is a bit higher than average. Only other self parking option is the mall parking?  Felt not secure.

Little to no drawer or clothing storage.  We only stayed one night and with a single bedside drawer that was even tight. 

This hotel felt like an extension of the mall even to the point they share parking and walkways. Just be aware of this when booking!

Overall on our Scottsdale stay for off season was an OK choice and they still have time to elevate the experience before on season and attempting to charge premium fees vs the other contenders in the immediate area like Andaz, Mountain Shadows, etc.

reviews.author: Venture58948842926
reviews.title: Warning! Scammers
reviews.text: Warning! Be ware of this place…Over charged, no follow through by management, they will add charges to your account take picture of everything in the room from the mini bar before you leave otherwise added to your folio. Do not expect a call back from a manager.

reviews.author: Grace Koval
reviews.title: Worst hospitality experience ever
reviews.text: Booked this hotel for a staycation with friends. First room had a broken AC. We moved rooms to a smaller room that had broken outlets and clock/speaker. We were running late to dinner but were moved (but promised an upgrade) to the same room two floors up. Lowest your AC is allowed to go is 68. The pool party accepted anyone and everyone. Including a man wearing denim jeans and a leather belt swimming in the pool. They charged my card the full amount after promising they would fix the $50 resort credit I got with my rate and remove the Resort Fee since the amenities weren't working. Valet is $40, self parking is $28. same garage for both. Will not visit again. ONLY nice thing about this hotel were the beds. And Annalee on the rooftop pool.

reviews.author: Anna D
reviews.title: Very poor customer service and Racist and nasty!
reviews.text: Hi, my is Tammy I would like to let everyone know that this is a horrible place to stay, I got in Saturday night, my daughter-in-law, my granddaughters, and I came here for Mother’s Day hearing many wonderful things about this hotel resort, got into our room it was nice. I am mortified that my granddaughter had that on her so-called prestigious resort I would’ve been better off going to a Motel 6 and I would’ve got treated with respect I give this place zero stars if I can, and I will not. $1500 surprise brunch that they promised that was going to be complementary. This is a horrible place. It’s a scam stay away. Spend your time somewhere else. Anywhere would be better than this place. I’ve spent my whole weekend chasing down manager after manager and I am so glad that I am leaving to go home tomorrow ugliest place ever because of the people no compassion for my 15-year-old that jumped in bed and had a dirty condom on her. Anything is better than this place every single person that works here is a scam other than Devon was wonderful. I just feel bad that he’s connected to all these ugly minded people.!!

reviews.author: lifenspice
reviews.title: Allergic to this hotel
reviews.text: I stayed at Caesar’s Republic in Scottsdale for a work meeting last week and many people, including me, had respiratory reactions to the large ballroom where much of our meeting occurred, as well as other areas in the hotel. The issues resolved as soon as we left the hotel. Do not stay if you are sensitive to chemicals from new carpet and wallpaper

reviews.author: Stephanie Nieszel
reviews.title: Love!
reviews.text: Lovely boutique property in the heart of Scottsdale.  The staff couldn't be kinder. Always available to help.  The property is spotless. Guestroom have floor to ceiling windows with stunning views.  Dined at both restaurants.  Book! You won't be disappointed
